It is understandable that you are concerned about your friend's sudden weight loss. While it is possible she might be taking a weight-loss medication and prefers to keep it private, unexplained weight loss can also be a sign of underlying medical issues, severe stress, or mental health struggles. Rather than assuming she is trying to trick anyone, she might just be dealing with something personal or medical that she isn't ready to share yet. 

The best approach is to check in with her from a place of care rather than suspicion. You could gently mention that you've noticed she has lost weight and ask how she is feeling overall. Let her know you are there to support her, whatever might be going on. Offering a safe, non-judgmental space will make it much easier for her to open up to you when she is ready.
